📦 Usage Notes
    Fully vanilla-compatible – no mods required.
    Designed for logistic bot supply chains.

🧑‍🔧 Required User Input (Only 2 Steps)
    Set the desired item to be produced
        Place the corresponding assembler or production building and set the recipe.
    Configure the production amount and material data
        In the Arithmetic/Comparison Combinator, set the desired production quantity.
        In the Constant Combinator, configure:
            A = target amount
            M = required input items (i.e. materials per product × amount)
    ⚠️ These values affect how much is requested in the requester chest – adapt them depending on the recipe

Modular Production Complex – Scalable Smart Factory

📝 Description
This blueprint features a fully designed modular complex for automated, intelligent production in Factorio. The setup is scalable and tileable: each complex handles one defined production task with integrated control and logic systems. Complexes can be chained together both horizontally and vertically, using built-in alignment markings and belt positions.
⚙️ Functions per Complex

    📦 Request Logic
        Continuously checks if materials are arriving via the input belt.
        If no items arrive for a while, a logistic request is automatically sent via a requester chest.
        Ensures the complex self-supplies via logistic bots without manual intervention.

    🔢 Production Quantity Control
        Signal A defines the target quantity to be produced.
        Signal M represents the required materials, calculated as A × ingredients per item.
        Both values are used to calculate precise logistic demands and production limits.

    📦 Inventory Monitoring
        The Storage Chest is monitored for the target amount (defined by signal A).
        Once the requested quantity is available, the factory stops automatically.
        A blue lamp lights up to indicate the job is complete.

    💡 Status Indicator
        Blinking green lamp = production is active.
        White lamp = idle mode, waiting for new orders or material.
        Instantly shows which complexes are working or done at a glance.

🏗️ Construction & Expansion
    The lower-left input belt tile acts as the snap anchor for placement.
    Belts serve as both item transport and visual alignment guides.
    Each module is designed for seamless tiling with additional units.
    Use the default build system with H or V to mirror horizontally or vertically, ideal for symmetric layouts or compact cluster setups.

🧱 Blueprint Contents
    Main Complex: One full module with all four functions integrated.
    Deconstructed Parts: Additional sections illustrate each function in isolation:
        Request logic only
        Production control only
        Inventory check only
        Status indicator only
This allows for easy understanding, testing, or customizing parts of the system.
title: Modular Production Complex – Scalable Smart Factory
